messages:
mira: summary from tonight's onboarding fuzz run against int4-v2 (batch=4): ~9% parseable-but-wrong args, ~11% JSON syntax failures on 1.2k samples
jon: ouch. Any clear classes of failures?
mira: two big buckets: trailing/extra commas and split-brace sequences where stream chunking cuts inside a token
anya: examples?
mira: fuzzer snippets:

```
fuzzer-bot: s_021.json
{"tool":"set_pref","args":{"user":42,"prefs":{"theme":"dark"},}}
```

```
fuzzer-bot: s_114.json
{"tool":"notify","args":{"user":99,"msg":"hi"}
}
```

mira: trailing comma and a brace split across chunks respectively
kevin: hypothesis: quantization shifts tokenization so punctuation lands on different subtoken boundaries; combined with continuous batching our chunker can flush in the middle of a JSON token
jon: why does retry make it worse?
mira: runtime retry currently replays the last N tokens; if original emission was fractured, replay duplicates fragment tails -> duplicated keys or stray punctuation
ci-bot: telemetry: funcall.parse_errors spiked 9.6x during run; retry_count median rose 0.0 -> 1.2
anya: quick mitigations?
kevin: short-term canary: inject a tiny sentinel prefix ("<<JSON>>\n") before the model JSON and strip it at runtime. For int4-v2 + batch>1 only
mira: quick test: sentinel reduced syntax failures by ~70% on a 200-sample smoke
jon: risk: customers who ingest raw model text might be affected if stripping fails
anya: secondary mitigation: server-side sanitizer that removes trailing commas, balances braces, and runs a fast NDJSON-lint. If sanitizer mutates, emit metric and attach original to audit bucket
kevin: longer-term: change stream reassembly to prefer waiting for token completion at chunk boundaries when latency budget allows; and avoid naive replay in retry actor (replay whole last sentence rather than last N tokens)
mira: action items:
- INF-6482: capture corpus + repro steps (mira)
- kevin: implement sentinel canary + reassembly guard
- anya: implement sanitizer + metric "sanitizer_mutations" and a dry-run toggle
- mira: run 10k-sample overnight fuzz and report morning
ci-bot: ticket INF-6482 created: "quantized-stream-reassembly-fuzz-onboarding"
fuzzer-bot: corpus uploaded s3://redwood-fuzz/int4-v2/4319999000/ 1.2k samples
jon: schedule 30m triage tomorrow 10:00 PT. thanks team :thumbsup:
